purpose: Execute all identifiable manuscript experimental families and disclose every source gap; not assert universal agreement with the paper.
main_schedule: Adam100000 per field; coupled100000 total, sequential200000 total; alternating20000-update field blocks
architecture_schedule: Coupled hard-Dirichlet L-BFGS10000 updates; depth1,2,4,5,6 at width40; width5,10,20,40,60 at depth5
timing_schedule: 25 combinations,100 L-BFGS updates each, run without another study process on GPU
remark7: Separate1M Adam continuation of the preserved100k rectangle run; softBC is an explicit reconstruction assumption. Source time on AppleM2Pro cannot be reproduced on RTX3090.

methodological_choices.physics: Consistent3D plane-strain thermal stress, engineering shear, roller tangential traction, as documented in original project. Inconsistent printed expanded equations are not silently used.
methodological_choices.mixed_energy: Authors' public-code work terms (--energy authors), as the clearest executable source. Printed manuscript energy variant remains available but differs.
methodological_choices.baseline_boundary_conditions: Primary standard/DEM reconstructions use soft unit penalties. Additional hard-Dirichlet DEM coupled/sequential sensitivity controls distinguish penalty bias from method limitations.
methodological_choices.circle_sampling: 51x51 Cartesian grid plus2399 seeded uniform random interior points gives5000 points. The unpublished exact Fig5 interface/boundary-enriched point distribution is not reproduced; equal-point weighting follows the chosen implementation and is not area-exact quadrature.
methodological_choices.dem_thermal_stop_gradient: In coupled DEM, the mechanical energy treats temperature as prescribed (stop-gradient), whereas coupled standard/mixed losses retain mechanical-loss derivatives into the thermal network. This one-way variational reconstruction is physically motivated but is not literal joint u,T minimization of the manuscript Eq14 wording. Method comparisons therefore depend on this disclosed choice.
methodological_choices.sequential_optimizer: Both mixed and baseline reset mechanical Adam state at each new mechanical block after temperature changes. Paper optimizer-state policy is unspecified.
methodological_choices.material: 50x50 nodal-averaged bilinear coefficient field in PINNs. Standard PINN collocation avoids interpolation knots and differentiates coefficients. SharpFEM references retain the distinction.
methodological_choices.transfer: Paired matrix/inclusion ratios1..10,10000Adam per ratio, weights[0,0.1,0.5,1],test15 held out. Fourth weight0.5 is a declared reconstruction choice.
methodological_choices.transfer_inputs: x,y and two log10 global ratios identify the complete BVP; source prose describes local E,k, which is ambiguous in the unchanged matrix.
methodological_choices.transfer_data_loss: Raw mean-squared error over eight fields; Section4.4 does not fully specify its normalization.
methodological_choices.transfer_boundary_conditions: SoftDirichlet reconstruction follows Eq65 including the full physics loss. Hard/soft treatment is not explicitly stated in Section4.4.
methodological_choices.checkpoint_selection: Last scheduled update only; no held-out tuning or cherry-picking successful seeds.
methodological_choices.acceleration: CUDAgraph Adam is used for full Adam runs. Standard PINN uses exact analytic tanh spatial derivatives (jets); mixed/DEM retain autograd. Parameter gradients remain automatic. Values and parameter gradients were verified against autograd; graph replay against eager-capturable Adam. Standard benchmark194.15to78.52ms/update; mixed jets and torch.compile were slower and are not used. Operation ordering can change floating-point trajectories. No budget or precision reduction.

required_reporting: Eight-field direct mixed and constitutive-derived errors
Mean and maximum absolute error plus explicitly defined relative normalizations
StandardPINN/DEM failure or success without forcing manuscript ranking
HardAdam versus hardL-BFGS objective and errors
Architecture sigma_xx exception checked rather than assumed
Transfer qx maximum-error exception and data-only runtime advantage checked rather than assumed
Complete figure/table coverage with unidentifiable original settings declared
